newsitem.title: UK: Air Canada drop cargo surchrge from April 15.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada drop cargo surchrge from April 15.

text.p: Air Canada is removing its air cargo fuel surcharges with effect from April 15, a spokeswomen for the carrier said here.
The surcharge was set at 10 U.S. cents kilo effective November 25 last year which equated to six pence a kilo in the UK, C5 cents or 15 pfennig in Germany.
On March 13 Delta Airlines was the first to remove its surcharge but in the last two days several major European carriers with the exception of British Airways have followed suit.
